meta: Pipe burst and water spreading? Shut the main off and call. We stop the flood and repair the pipe in Oakley, CA. Clear price first. Call (888) 910-8644.
lead: Burst pipe repair in Oakley, CA begins with stopping the water, then replacing the failed section of pipe. Call us once the main valve is closed and we will take it from there.
intro: A burst pipe is a supply or drain line that has split, cracked or blown a joint, releasing water into a wall, ceiling, garage or yard. In Oakley, a split pipe can empty into a house fast because the supply line runs under steady pressure from Diablo Water District.
This page starts with the shutoff steps, then covers where the main valve is, how copper, PEX, CPVC and galvanized pipe are repaired, when a broken pipe means more work and what changes the price.

sections.h2: A pipe has burst and water is pouring in right now
paras: Speed matters, so do the first steps before you pick up the phone if you can reach the valve safely. Our 24/7 emergency dispatch takes the call at any hour, and the list below keeps the damage down until a plumber arrives.
do_now: Close the main shutoff valve at the house by turning it fully clockwise, or the lever a quarter turn across the pipe.
Open the lowest faucet and the outdoor hose bib to drain the line and drop the pressure.
Shut off electricity to any room where water is near outlets, switches or ceiling lights.
A gas smell near the water heater changes everything: get outside, call 911, then PG&E at 1-800-743-5000, and only then phone a plumber.
Soak up standing water with towels, move belongings and photograph everything before you clean up.
Call (888) 910-8644 and tell us what burst, where the water is going and whether it has stopped.

sections.h2: Where to find the shutoff before you need it
paras: Most homeowners search for the main valve while water is already running. Spend ten minutes locating each of these now.

items.d: Look where the supply line enters the building, often in a garage, utility closet or on an exterior wall.
A curb-side box holds the meter and a shutoff on the district side. Use it only if the house valve fails.
Sinks and toilets have small valves that isolate one fixture without shutting off the whole house.
A cold-water valve on the tank shuts off feed if the burst is at the heater.

sections.h2: What actually fails and why pipes split
paras: Pipes burst when pressure, age or damage exceeds what the material can take. Corroded galvanized steel gives way from the inside, soldered copper joints can come undone, and CPVC can turn brittle with age. Hard freezes are uncommon in Oakley, but exposed outdoor pipes and hose bibs can still crack in a cold snap.

Cracked fittings, damaged drain pipes and a wall leak found during a repair are also common. If a burst has no obvious cause, our [[leak-detection|leak detection]] work can check the rest of the system for a second weak spot.
The [[plumber-magnolia-park-oakley-ca|Magnolia Park page]] shows how to tell whether a leak is on the supplier side or the house side of the meter.

sections.h2: Which side of the meter your burst is on in Oakley
paras: The District owns the pipe from the street main to your meter, and you own what runs past it into the house. A burst inside the house or in the yard after the meter is the owner's repair, and a break upstream of the meter goes to the district at (925) 625-3798.

If water is erupting in the street or the meter box itself, close your house valve anyway and phone the district. If the break location is unclear, call the District first so nobody digs on the wrong side of the line. Replacement sections are expected to meet the California Plumbing Code, whose model text is the Uniform Plumbing Code (UPC), so a repair is more than a patch.

sections.h2: When one burst means a bigger plumbing decision
paras: A single split on healthy pipe is a simple repair. Repeated breaks on the same system tell a different story, and aging galvanized or brittle CPVC lines may be better replaced than patched. Our [[repiping|repiping]] service replaces the supply system when it is wearing out.

If the burst is under a concrete floor, the repair plan changes, and we cover that on our [[slab-leak-repair|slab leak repair]] page. Homes in nearby [[plumber-brentwood-ca|Brentwood]] follow the same steps, though that city runs its own water system.

sections.h2: What changes the price of burst pipe repair
paras: The scope and the number are settled first. The final figure depends on these factors.

factors.d: A pipe in an open garage is quick. One behind finished drywall or tile adds opening and patching.
Copper, PEX, CPVC and galvanized differ in parts and labor.
A short section is a small fix. Corroded runs may need a longer replacement.
Emergency visits at night or on weekends can price differently from a scheduled one, and we offer same-day appointments when available.
Drying, drywall and flooring are separate from the plumbing repair.

sections.insurance: Sudden and accidental water damage is often covered by homeowner policies, while gradual leaks and wear usually are not. Photograph the burst and the damage, keep the broken pipe if you can and ask your insurer what applies.
sections.call_line: Call (888) 910-8644 and we can discuss the repair and the price.

paras: Turn the water back on slowly and check the repair for drips over the next hour. Run each faucet for a few minutes to clear air and any sediment. Keep an eye on the meter for a day or two, and ask your plumber whether the surrounding pipe looks sound.

faqs.q: What is the first thing to do when a pipe bursts?
a: Close the main shutoff valve, open a low faucet to drain pressure and switch off power near the water. Then call for repair.

faqs.q: Do you handle burst pipe repair emergencies at night or on weekends in Oakley?
a: Yes, our 24/7 emergency dispatch covers burst pipes at any hour. Call (888) 910-8644 after you have closed the main valve.

faqs.q: Can a cracked pipe be repaired without replacing everything?
a: Often, yes. A cracked section can be cut out and replaced, or a sleeve or coupling added to copper. If the surrounding pipe is corroded, a longer replacement or repipe makes more sense.

faqs.q: Do you repair galvanized and copper pipe?
a: Yes. Copper is cut and re-joined, and galvanized sections are replaced, usually with newer pipe. We explain the choice before work starts.

faqs.q: Who pays if the pipe in the street or meter box bursts?
a: The break is the District's problem only if it sits before the meter or backflow device. Phone the District to learn exactly where its pipe stops on your lot.

faqs.q: Will insurance cover the damage from a burst pipe?
a: Many policies cover sudden and accidental damage but not gradual wear. Ask your insurer, and document the damage with photos before cleanup.

cta_mid: Water stopped at the main but the pipe still needs fixing? Call and describe what burst and where.
cta_end: A split pipe floods fast, so close the valve and call now to get repair and drying underway.
